lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spot clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, with higher density observed posterior to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a rectangular grid of nodes most visible in the central third of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient runs longitudinally along the upper flank, parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately 12 distinct high-luminance blobs of varying diameters contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, low-intensity pixel cluster is visible ventrally beneath the posterior trunk, consistent with the silhouette of a commensal organism.
